digest.component_or_area: code-review criterion and CI gate compatibility
propositions: New hard-fail CI gates break branches created or in-flight before the gate was added, with no grandfathering mechanism to prevent ungrandfathered gates from landing review-clean.
A project-owned advisory code-review criterion should assess whether pipeline/gate-configuration changes introduce hard-fail steps or required gates without if-present/grandfather guards.

Project code-review criteria must be gated by file-path globs rather than unconditionally dispatched, using declarative applies_to glob patterns across multiple CI vendors (GitHub, GitLab, Jenkins, CircleCI, Buildkite, Bitbucket, Drone, Azure Pipelines).
The glob set must be project-overridable via a config key so unusual pipelines are declared by the project rather than enumerated in shipped code.

Triggered via applies_to globs in criteria_routing.json (portable mechanism) rather than hardcoded CI-vendor-specific paths, to preserve tech-agnosticism and support any CI provider including projects with no CI provider.
